scope: Public-safe name-free reference excerpts and team championship/structure brief. Originals and full contact sheet excluded.
method: Tightly bounded source-pixel excerpts; no generative reconstruction, no geometry/text replacement, no upscaling. Crops may intentionally clip parts of banners; use text manifest for exact wording and wall positions.

files.metadata_check: No EXIF, GPS, XMP, ICC or JPEG comment; only basic JFIF
files.pixel_privacy_review: Visually inspected full excerpt. No people, individual names, rosters, individual-award boards, or handwritten achievement lists are visible.
